Instead, we would recommend a similar approach to the health.gov.au "Minisites" custom functionality,
where each study is categorized by a taxonomy.
This would allow to leverage all existing functionality of the AIFS website while also giving the possibility
to add customisation to each study as per requirements. It would also allow to use the provided
codebase for "Minisites" as a reference, and potentially reuse some of the helper functions that will
need to be rebuild (as per item #5 in solution outline).
